question_text: Describe how to build a BST of unique asset identifiers from a two-dimensional list containing Asset objects or None.
adaptation_rationale: BST insertion and 2Dtraversal explicit. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Start with an empty tree; traverse all rows/positions; skip None. For each asset, use its identifier as key, compare from the root and follow smaller/larger subtrees until an empty child position is found, then insert there.

marking_points.criterion: Initial empty tree and all-cell traversal.
Follows correct smaller/larger branch from root.
Inserts at empty position, including root when initially empty.
